name: Kneeling Push-Up
cues: Kneel and place your hands a little wider than your shoulders
Brace so your hips stay level with your shoulders
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees
Push back up until your arms are straight

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: Knees rest 5 mm into the floor and stay within 1 cm. Balls of the feet are planted, toes tucked, hips straight (flex 2), pitch 36→11, chest 9.7 cm off the floor at the bottom. Ankle DF is pinned at its 40 deg stop and toe flex at -59.5 against the -60 stop, both at the limit for the whole rep. Bottom flare is 35 deg against the cue's 'about 45'.
